snippet.title: Switch the Darkness - Indie Horror Game
snippet.description:
This Light Switch Mechanic Will Haunt You - Horror Game
The SCARIEST Indie Horror Game Coming Soon...

This door hides a secret you aren't meant to see. 🚫 Welcome to "Switch the Darkness" — where light is your only weapon and your worst enemy.

One house. One switch. 9 nights. It seemed simple at first, but this indie horror game takes psychological terror to the next level. Every time I touched the switch, the house changed. New objects appeared, shadows moved, and I realized I wasn't alone.

If you like games like The Exit 8 or P.T., you need to see this.

Don't forget to LIKE and SUBSCRIBE if you survived the video! 🔔

#indiehorror #horror #gaming #switchthedarkness #newgames2025 #analoghorror #creepy
